name: Hòn Chồng
kicker: The stacked rocks on the north shore
summary: Hòn Chồng is the rock promontory in Vĩnh Phước. The provincial digital guide prints 06:00–18:00 and no ticket. Hòn Vợ is about 100 m south. Hòn Đỏ is about 300 m southeast. An assembly hall on the site was built from December 2004 to March 2005 for the 2005 bay-club conference.
getThere: Hòn Chồng, Vĩnh Phước. Minutes from Trần Phú were not printed.
heroCaption: The stacked rocks of Hòn Chồng, with the bay and the hills
body: The provincial digital guide places Hòn Chồng to the north of this shore, Hòn Vợ about 100 m south, and Hòn Đỏ about 300 m southeast. Hours are 06:00–18:00. A ticket is not printed. The address line is Hòn Chồng, Vĩnh Phước.

The assembly hall was built between December 2004 and March 2005 for the bay-club conference that year. The visit is the rocks and the water. Minutes from the city sand were not printed. Po Nagar is the other stop on this northern shore, about 2 km from the centre.
